outing.copy_body: 不追一场演出，也能来看看建筑。沿三座银色粮仓走到树林，把文化区当作一座可散步的公园。 路线：北京艺术中心 → 绿心露天剧场 → 城市绿心森林公园。约2–3小时，到首站和返程另计。演出不含在时长内；场馆参观与座席开放查预约，公共道路以现场为准。

Adult walker with a folded coat, mint-blue original editorial collage, realistic distinctive ribbed facades. Original peaceful composition; any people are adults in everyday opaque clothing. Rich full-bleed vertical 1024x1536 scene with specific architecture and concrete activity, no text, labels, logo, watermark, fake map, or reproduced artwork.
